mapper.insert: insert into member (id, pw, name, discnt_time, phone, email, auth, car_num, car_type) values (#{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, 200, #{phone}, #{email}, #{auth}, #{car_num}, #{car_type})
mapper.select: select id, name, discnt_time, phone, email, auth, car_num, car_type from member where id=#{id}

select car.car_stat AS "car_stat", car.spc_no AS "spc_no", space.floor AS "floor", car.ent_time AS "ent_time", car.discnt_at AS "discnt_at", member.auth AS "auth"
from car
join member on car.id = member.id
left join space on car.spc_no = space.spc_no
where car.id = #{id}
order by car.ent_time desc
limit 1
select ent_time AS "ent_time", ex_time AS "ex_time", cost AS "cost", discnt_at AS "discnt_at" from car where id = #{id} and ex_time is not null order by ex_time desc limit 10
